title: Module 5 Current — vs. Peer Band (Modules 1–4,6–8 Avg ± 2σ)

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.machine == "2406-176021" and
    r._field == "Module5_Current_A"
  )
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Module 5 (Actual)")

  |> group()
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(
      identity: {t: time(v: 0), count: 0, sum: 0.0, sumSq: 0.0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({

          count: accumulator.count + 1,
          sum: accumulator.sum + r._value,
          sumSq: accumulator.sumSq + r._value * r._value,

      return {_time: r.t, _value: mean + 2.0 * std}
  })
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Upper Band")
